issues.on_page: Motor vehicle tax: General 363,094, Bond 1,434, QCPU 323
issues.issue: The Bond (1,434, p12) and QCPU (323, p14) amounts in this statement line are printed as 'Pro-rate motor vehicle' on their fund schedules, which is state aid. So 1,757 of state aid sits inside the motor vehicle tax line. Amount is correct as printed; minor category mix.

Fines and license fees the county passes on to schools could be fines and forfeitures or licenses and permits instead. Intergovernmental is defensible because the statement groups it under 'County receipts'.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund reported within Other Governmental Funds column
issues.issue: The extractor rules list school nutrition as a business-type example, but this report presents it as a governmental fund and has no proprietary statement. Treating it as governmental follows the report; confirm this is intended.

issues.on_page: Support services - students, Other Governmental Funds column 508,505
issues.issue: The split by fund column is printed on the page and the Activities Fund disbursements (p19) tie to it. But the statement puts this amount under the support services function, so recategorizing it as student activities is a judgment call (already marked review).
